question: Should OpenClaw expose outbound delivery failures to agents as a shared system event, structured message-tool/agent delivery status, or both?
rationale: This changes model-visible context, channel/plugin SDK expectations, and recovery semantics, so the permanent contract needs maintainer intent before implementation.

options.title: Shared typed delivery contract
options.body: Define one status/failure contract over existing durable outbound outcomes and decide exactly where agents observe it.

options.title: Tool/status only
options.body: Limit the feature to structured tool or agent result status and avoid injecting new system events into session context.

options.title: Keep narrower mechanisms
options.body: Leave current CLI, cron, restart-recovery, and channel-specific behavior as the supported path and close this direction separately if maintainers do not want model-visible delivery failures.

recommendation.title: Shared typed delivery contract
recommendation.body: Define one status/failure contract over existing durable outbound outcomes and decide exactly where agents observe it.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history trail for outbound delivery and agent/message-tool boundaries points to steipete.
